messages.text: why is the crypto payment such a scam?

Sorry, Patrick, what happened on your end? Did the crypto option fail at checkout, or did a payment go out and not register?

Either way I can get Georges on it, he handles crypto payments here directly and can send you a proper invoice with the rate worked out. Tell me which coin you wanted to pay with and roughly what went wrong, and I'll pass it straight to him.

you only have 10 minutes before changing the price. and at this time there was a block duration over 20 minutes... now i tried to pay twice... but it didn't work. had to pay over 60 € for the refund...
Handed to the team · crypto checkout window too short, customer out of pocket on fees, needs a manual

That's a real problem, and 60 euros in fees for two payments that never landed is not on you. The 10-minute rate lock on the gateway is too tight when the network is slow, I hear you.

Georges handles crypto here manually. He can send you an invoice with the rate worked out and a wallet address, so there's no countdown, and he'll look at the fees you lost. He's been pinged and will jump into this chat. Stay here if you can, otherwise it comes to your email.
